evals.prompt: Monta o prompt dessa cena pro Seedance 2.5 no Higgsfield: um pescador velho no litoral do Ceará ensina o neto de 10 anos a consertar uma rede ao amanhecer, na praia, antes de saírem pro mar. O avô fala uma frase só: 'Nó frouxo, peixe solto.' Quero algo bem cinematográfico e real, 16:9. Tenho a foto do rosto do avô, a do neto e uma foto da jangada.
evals.expected_output: One Seedance 2.5 prompt (single generation) with references mapped to roles, the line in Brazilian Portuguese labelled with speaker/seconds/accent, an acting task for both faces, net-mending as mechanics, motivated dawn light, music ban, plus generation settings (duration = timeline, 16:9, attachments in order).
expectations: Delivers a single Seedance 2.5 prompt in English with the spoken line kept verbatim in Portuguese ('Nó frouxo, peixe solto.')
The line is labelled with speaker, start/end seconds and a named language/accent (Brazilian Portuguese / Ceará)
The grandson's mouth is explicitly locked shut / only the grandfather speaks
Each of the three photos is given one explicit job (identity, identity, object/boat) and a scope excluding their background/light
Both faces get an acting task built on a tactic (verbs at the partner), not emotion adjectives
Net mending is written as mechanics (needle/shuttle, knot, pull, resistance or test), not just 'mends the net'
Music is explicitly banned with at least one synonym (score, BGM, soundtrack, instrumental)
Subtitles / on-screen text are explicitly banned
A motivated, directional dawn light source is named with its side/direction
Generation settings are given: duration that equals the sum of the timed beats, 16:9, and which references to attach

evals.prompt:
Decupa esse trecho em prompts pro Seedance 2.5 (21:9) e me dá o shotlist:

INT. HOSPITAL — CORREDOR DA UTI — NOITE
CLARA (40) espera sentada, segurando um copo de café que já esfriou. A porta da UTI abre. DR. RUIZ (55) sai tirando a máscara.
RUIZ: Ele está estável. Mas não acordou.
CLARA: Posso entrar?
RUIZ: Só cinco minutos.
Clara entra. Pela janelinha da porta vemos ela segurar a mão do pai. Ruiz fica olhando pela janelinha um instante, depois vai embora pelo corredor.
evals.expected_output: An HTML shotlist (and the prompts) splitting the scene into one or more Seedance 2.5 generations with timed shots, PT-BR lines labelled, acting tasks for Clara and Ruiz (including Ruiz as the observer at the end), axis/continuity locks, generation cards.
expectations: An HTML shotlist file is produced with the prompts inside copyable blocks
The scene is split into generations whose timed shots add up to each generation's stated duration, each within Seedance 2.5's 30 s limit
The three dialogue lines are kept verbatim in Portuguese and labelled by speaker with seconds
Dr. Ruiz has an acting task that covers the final silent beat watching through the door window
The shot through the small door window of Clara holding her father's hand is covered
A spatial/axis or screen-side continuity lock is stated for Clara and Ruiz
Music is explicitly banned in every prompt
Each generation has settings (duration, 21:9 aspect, references/attachments) listed
The user's script is not rewritten (no new dialogue lines added)

evals.prompt: Gerei esse take no Seedance 2.5 e ficou ruim. Era pra ser uma mulher de uns 30 anos, sozinha numa floresta à noite, acendendo uma fogueira com pederneira, 15 segundos. Saiu com música de fundo, a fogueira já aparece acesa logo no começo, a luz parece de estúdio e o rosto dela ficou com olhar vidrado de boneca. O prompt que usei foi: 'A woman lights a campfire in a dark forest at night, cinematic, dramatic lighting, 4k, beautiful, emotional.' Me ajuda a consertar.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis of each failure (music, skipped process, flat studio light, glassy eyes) with causes, and a rebuilt Seedance 2.5 prompt with the fire-making process as timed mechanics, a single motivated light source, an acting task + living eyes, a music ban with synonyms, and generation settings.
expectations: Diagnoses all four reported failures (background music, fire already lit at the start, studio-like light, glassy doll eyes) with a cause for each
Explains why the original prompt's words (cinematic, dramatic lighting, beautiful, emotional, 4k) contributed to the failure
The rebuilt prompt shows the fire-making process in timed steps starting before any flame exists (strike, sparks, tinder catching, blowing, flame)
The rebuilt prompt names a single motivated light source and states what stays dark / exposure decision
The rebuilt prompt contains an acting task with a tactic and a living-eyes / anti-frozen-pupil instruction
Music is banned with synonyms in the rebuilt prompt
The timeline adds up to 15 seconds and the duration setting is 15 s
The prompt opens with the action already in progress and/or ends hard mid-action
